lines.name: H2 offtake
lines.note: Served H2 offtake in kg (LHV); linked_share is the sold share. Price per kg is yours: no public offtake benchmark, the premium is paid on top.

lines.name: Production premium
lines.note: Fixed premium per kg of verified output, typed: the kg a year you are awarded (the contract caps it). Typed, not linked, because a second line on the served H2 would add its sold share to the offtake's and could drop the whole lost-production penalty (G3 counts a shortfall once).

hint.source: European Hydrogen Bank pilot auction, premiums requested by the 7 winners
hint.note: Fixed premium per kg verified output, up to 10 years: set start_year and end_year for the tenor. Ceiling 4.50 EUR/kg.

lines.name: Balance of plant
lines.note: Plant capex not in the energy model's asset capex (balance of plant, installation, buildings): the base of non-energy O&M and insurance. Capex is priced once: do not re-enter the electrolyser. No sourced default: enter the price and life.

lines.name: Stack replacement
lines.note: Quantity: one lump per replacement event; set refresh_years to the stack life in years (operating hours ÷ hours per year). Reference: 15 % of direct electrolyser capex per replacement at a 40,000 h interval (DOE/NREL 2022, PEM; alkaline 80,000 h, IRENA 2021). No default: the price depends on your electrolyser capex.

lines.name: Non-energy O&M
lines.note: Share of the capex lines above per year. The electrolyser's own fixed O&M is already in the energy model's ledger (locked rows); this covers the plant capex you enter here. Default is the pack's electrolyser fixed O&M share (DEA, assumed).

lines.name: Staff
lines.note: FTE count per year. No sourced default: enter the quantity and the price.

lines.name: Insurance
lines.note: Share of capex per year. No sourced default for hydrogen plant: enter the share.

line.name: Oxygen sales (electrolyser)
line.note: Electrolyser O2 at 7.94 kg per kg H2. Rarely sold: needs an on-site offtaker. Off until you add it.
